items.name: 01 Table Rules
items.text:
/p Table Rules: <wait.1>
/p - Minimum Bet: 100,000 gil | Maximum Bet: 500,000 gil <wait.1>
/p - Blackjack pays 3:2, Dealer stands on soft 17 or above. <wait.1>
/p - One split maximum. Players may not Double Down on Splits. <wait.1>
/p - A Dealer natural BlackJack defeats all non-natural hands, and Player natural BlackJack pushes against a dealer natural Blackjack. <wait.1>
/p - A Player natural BlackJack may accept an "Even Money" 1:1 payment on their turn if the Dealer's up-card is Ace. <wait.1>
/p - If Player accepts "Even Money" they are paid and removed from the remainder of the hand. <wait.1>
/p - Card values: 1 = Ace, 2-10 = Face Value, 11-13 = Jack, Queen, and King respectively.
items.title: Table Rules

items.name: 02 Open Betting
items.text:
/p ★ Welcome to Apollo Blackjack! The table is now accepting wagers. <wait.1>
/p Minimum Wager: 100,000 gil | Maximum Wager: 500,000 gil <wait.1>
/p Bets will be collected and cards will be dealt clockwise around the table. Please trade your wager when called. <wait.1>
/p ☀ May Apollo's light favor the bold. Place your bets! <se.2>
items.title: Open Betting

items.name: 03 Betting Closed
items.text:
/victorypose motion
/p ◆ All offerings have been received. Betting is now CLOSED. <wait.1>
/p ☀ The Fates are set. Let us begin.
items.title: Betting Closed

items.name: 04 Dealer 1st Card
items.text:
/battlestance motion
/p The Fates offer us a glimpse of the future as the game begins. The Dealer shall receive their first card.
/wait 1
/dice party 13
items.title: Dealer's First Card

items.name: 05 Begin Hand
items.text:
/battlestance motion
/p ☀ <t> , your hand shall now be revealed. May Apollo smile upon you. <se.1>
/wait 1
/dice party 13
/dice party 13
items.title: Begin Player Hand

items.before: If players first two cards are an Ace and a 10 or above valued card, and the dealer does not have an Ace as their up-card, the player wins BlackJack. Otherwise, move to Macro Set (06-O2-P1) if Dealer has Ace. If player does not have BlackJack skip this step and move to Macro Set (7).
items.name: 06-O1 Natural BJ
items.text:
/clap motion
/p ☀ <t> has been blessed by the Fates! Congratulations on your BlackJack! <se.15>
items.title: Natural Blackjack

items.before: If player has a natural BlackJack and the Dealer has Ace as the up-card, the player has the option to take Even Money which pays 1:1 on their original bet. If player accepts, proceed with Macro (06-O2-P2), otherwise, continue the game at Macro Set (07-O1)
items.name: 06-O2-P1 Even Money
items.text: /p <t> , you may accept an even payout to your original bet now, or you may risk a push if the Dealer has BlackJack. Which would you prefer?
items.title: Even Money

items.before: If Player BlackJack does not accept Even Money against Dealer Ace, skip this step and move to next player restarting at Macro Set (05). Player BlackJack will be played against the Dealer's hand at the end of the round
items.name: 06-O2-P2 Accept Even
items.text:
/thumbsup motion
/p <t> accepts Even Money! You will now be paid for your BlackJack! <se.2>
items.title: Accept Even Money

items.before: All hands have the option to Hit, Stand, or Double Down as their first option. If the first two cards of a hand are a matching pair or two cards valued 10 or above, use Macro (07-O2) instead.
items.name: 07-O1 Hit/Stand/DD
items.text: /p <t> , will you Hit, Stand, or Double Down?
items.title: Hit, Stand, Double Down

items.name: 07-O2 H/S/DD/Split
items.text: /p <t> , will you Hit, Stand, Double Down, or Split?
items.title: Hit, Stand, Double Down, or Split?

items.name: 08-O1 Hit
items.text:
/battlestance motion
/p ☀ <t> calls upon the Fates for another card... <se.4>
/wait 1
/dice party 13
items.title: Hit

items.name: 08-O2 Stand
items.text: /p ◆ <t> chooses to stand. Their fate is sealed.
items.title: Stand

items.after: After the wager is received, use Macro Set (08-O1). The player's hand then stands automatically. Move to the next player and restart with Macro Set (05)
items.before: Collect the player's matching wager before dealing the final card.
items.name: 08-O3 Double Down
items.text:
/rally motion
/p ◆ <t> doubles their offering to the Fates! <wait.1>
/p Please match your original wager to continue. One final card will then be drawn.
items.title: Double Down

items.after: After the matching wager is received, use macros (08-O1) and (08-O2) to conclude each hand. Split hands are ineligible for natural BlackJacks. All 21's received during splits are considered soft.
items.name: 08-O4 Split
items.text:
/thumbsup motion
/p ◆ <t> divides their fate and splits the hand in two! Please match your original wager to continue.
items.title: Split

items.before: after the player receives a third card, the only available options are to Hit or Stand. If player Stands during Macro Set (7), skip this step. Repeat this step until player Stands or Busts. If player stands, use Macro Set (08-O2). If player Busts, use Macro Set (09-O2).
items.name: 09-O1 Hit or Stand
items.text: /p <t> , will you Hit or Stand?
items.title: Hit or Stand?

items.after: For a split hand, continue to the player's second hand instead of moving to the next player. Following the conclusion of Macro Sets (08) and (09), restart at Macro Set (05) for the next player until all players have been dealt their cards
items.name: 09-O2 Player Bust
items.text:
/facepalm motion
/p ◆ <t> has BUSTED. Their hand is lost. May the Fates have a brighter future in store for you! <se.11>
items.title: Player Bust

items.name: 10 Dealer Turn
items.text:
/battlestance motion
/p ☀ The challengers have received their fate. Now the dealer must face their own...
/wait 1
/dice party 13
items.title: Dealer Turn

items.before: If dealer does not receive BlackJack, skip this step and continue with Macro Set (12)
items.name: 11 Dealer Natural BJ
items.text:
/facepalm motion
/p ☀ To the player's dismay, Apollo has blessed the house with a natural BlackJack. <se.11>
/wait 1
/p ◆ All non-Blackjack hands lose. Any player with a natural Blackjack pushes.
items.title: Dealer Natural Blackjack

items.name: 12-O1 Dealer Hit
items.text:
/battlestance motion
/p ◆ The house draws beneath Apollo's watch...
/wait 1
/dice party 13
items.title: Dealer Hit

items.name: 12-O2 Dealer Stand
items.text:
/p ◆ The house stands. Apollo's judgment is set. <wait.1>
/p ☀ All remaining hands will now be settled against the dealer.
items.title: Dealer Stand

items.name: 13 Dealer Bust
items.text:
/cheer motion
/p ◆ The dealer has BUSTED. The Fates favor the remaining challengers! <se.7>
items.title: Dealer Bust

items.name: 14 Player Win
items.text:
/clap motion
/p ◆ <t> defeats the house! <se.1>
items.title: Player Win

items.name: 15 Player Loss
items.text:
/facepalm motion
/p ◆ The house claims this hand. <t> falls short of the dealer. <se.11>
items.title: Player Loss

items.name: 16 Push
items.text:
/thumbsup motion
/p ◆ The Fates find balance. <t> ties with the dealer. <wait.1>
/p ☀ PUSH — the original wager remains. <se.3>
items.title: Push

items.after: Return to Macro Set (01) to begin the next round.
items.name: 17 Round Complete
items.text:
/em gathers the cards and prepares the table for another game beneath Apollo's watch.
/p ☀ The Fates have spoken. This round is complete. <wait.1>
/p ◆ Thank you for playing. A new round will begin shortly. <se.8>
items.title: Round Complete
